title: Runbook: Diagnosing 504 Gateway Timeouts & Connection Pool Saturation
content:
Step 1: Check logs for 'Connection refused' or 'Connection pool exhausted' log entries.
Step 2: Check query_metrics for active_connections or max_connection_limit.
Step 3: If active_connections equals max limit, verify downstream dependency latencies or recent deployment code changes before initiating rollback.

title: Runbook: Handling Third-Party Dependency Failures & Rate Limits
content:
Step 1: Inspect check_dependency_health for status degraded or HTTP 429 status codes.
Step 2: Check query_metrics for rate_limit_quota or error_rate.
Step 3: Verify if rate limit parameters were modified in the latest deployment or if third-party provider status page reports an incident.

title: Runbook: Database Lock Contention & Migration Safety
content:
Step 1: Compare compare_versions for database migration scripts in recent commits.
Step 2: Query query_metrics for database_lock_wait_time and active_db_connections.
Step 3: If lock wait time exceeds threshold (>5s), kill long-running DDL statements and roll back migration deployment.

title: Runbook: Memory Leak & Container OOM Diagnostic Procedure
content:
Step 1: Query query_metrics for process_memory_bytes over time.
Step 2: Check compare_versions for changes in background task handling or event listeners.
Step 3: If heap memory monotonically increases without garbage collection drops, restart deployment with memory profiling enabled.
